name: Hungary
description: Hungary from the Magyar conquest and Saint Stephen to the Ottoman wars, Austria-Hungary, 1956, the fall of communism and today.

checkpoints.name: The Magyar kingdom
checkpoints.note: The Magyars settled the Danube basin around 895. Stephen was crowned in 1000, and Matthias made Buda a Renaissance court.

checkpoints.name: Ottomans and Habsburgs
checkpoints.note: After Mohács in 1526 the Ottomans held the centre for 150 years. The Habsburgs then ruled, and the revolution of 1848 was crushed.

checkpoints.name: Austria-Hungary
checkpoints.note: The compromise of 1867 gave Hungary its own government, and Budapest boomed. Defeat in 1918 and the treaty of Trianon cut the country down.

checkpoints.name: Communism and after
checkpoints.note: Communists took power, and the revolution of 1956 was crushed. Hungary opened its border in 1989 and joined the European Union in 2004.
